title: Supercar & Picture Car Hire for Music Videos in London | Sourced.
description: Lamborghini, Ferrari, Rolls-Royce, G-Wagon and classic cars for music videos, film and fashion shoots in London. Picture vehicles and chauffeurs delivered to set.
h1: Supercar and picture car hire for shoots
lede: Lamborghinis, Ferraris, Rolls-Royce Cullinans, G-Wagons, Maybachs and classics, delivered to set for music videos, film, fashion and events.

hero.alt: Mercedes-AMG G63 picture car on a shoot

cta: Need hero cars for your shoot?

sections.text:
The car is often the star of the shot. Sourced. supplies supercars, luxury SUVs, classics and picture vehicles for music videos, adverts, film and fashion shoots across London, delivered to your location on the day.

Our current list includes the Lamborghini Aventador, Huracán and a full colour range of Urus and Urus Performante, the Ferrari 458 Italia, 488 GTB and Purosangue, Rolls-Royce Cullinans including Black Badge, Bentley Bentayga, Brabus and AMG G-Wagons, Defenders and Escalades. Need several of the same model in different colours? We can line up a fleet.

cards.d: Lamborghini and Ferrari in a range of colours and interiors for performance and music video shots.
Urus, Cullinan, Bentayga, G63, Defender and Escalade, including matching fleets.
Rolls-Royce Phantom and Maybach S-Class and GLS with drivers for talent and arrivals.
A 1967 Mustang, a 1963 Impala lowrider and a 1970s Rolls-Royce saloon for period and lifestyle shoots.
Police-livery BMWs with working lights, military vehicles, off-road buggies, quads and bikes for film and TV.
A specific model, colour or year? Put it in your brief and we'll find it.

sections.text: Add the cars you want from our listings, or describe the look. Tell us the date, location and whether the car needs to move on camera or stay static. We confirm availability and send one quote covering the cars, delivery and any drivers, alongside your location, transport and security if you need them.

faqs.q: Can the cars be driven on camera?
faqs.a: Often, yes, depending on the car and the shot. Tell us what the scene involves and we'll confirm what's possible for each vehicle.

faqs.q: Do you deliver the cars to set?
faqs.a: Yes. Cars are delivered to your location in London and the surrounding areas. Delivery is included in your quote.

faqs.q: Can I book several cars in matching or different colours?
faqs.a: Yes. We can line up fleets, for example several Urus Performantes in orange, red, yellow and green.
Yes. Our chauffeur cars, including the Rolls-Royce Phantom and Maybachs, come with drivers for talent arrivals and moves between locations.
